title: SA4 – Tier 3 "Legacy" (Kenya) hero: Athar-branded modular containerised data centre with solar canopy in Kenyan farmland; smallholder farmer using Swahili voice advice on a phone; clinic + school nearby
prompt: Kenyan farmland in the central highlands in warm late-afternoon light: rows of young maize, red-earth tracks, scattered acacia trees, soft white clouds. In the middle distance on the right stands one sovereign data-centre node: a single 40-foot shipping-container data centre painted matte Gulf Blue (#1E3A5F) on a low concrete plinth, with a white steel door and ventilation louvres, sheltered by a raised steel canopy of solar panels; on the long side of the container facing the camera is a large flat chroma-key green rectangular panel. Behind it, clearly visible, are a small rural health clinic (single-storey white building with a veranda) and a primary school (single-storey building with a corrugated roof and a small playground). In the foreground on the left a Kenyan woman smallholder farmer in a headwrap and practical work clothes stands among the maize, holding a smartphone at chest height and listening to it on speaker; the phone screen is tilted toward the camera and is a chroma-key green rectangle. Standing eye-level camera; the farmer in sharp focus on the left third. Ultra-realistic documentary photograph shot on a full-frame camera with a 35mm lens at f/4; natural directional daylight from one side; warm-neutral colour grade (cream, sand and soft parchment tones) with one deep Gulf Blue (#1E3A5F) element anchoring the frame; subtle natural film grain; true-to-life skin texture; accurate anatomy, natural relaxed hands with five fingers; candid, unposed, real people in a real work setting; no stock-photo gloss. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos, signage, UI or writing anywhere in the image. Every screen and every blank sign/certificate surface described is a flat, evenly lit, solid chroma-key green (#00B140) rectangle with crisp straight edges and square corners, matte, no reflections, no glare, no green light spill on people or objects. No robots, no holograms, no glowing brains, no neon, no sci-fi effects. Landscape 3:2 composition.
